meta.name: dask
meta.description: Distributed computing for larger-than-RAM pandas/NumPy workflows. Use when you need to scale existing pandas/NumPy code beyond memory or across clusters. Best for parallel file processing, distributed ML, integration with existing pandas code. For out-of-core analytics on single machine use vaex; for in-memory speed use polars.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将超出单机内存的数据分析任务扩展到分布式集群并行处理
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果数据处理量大到单机内存装不下
copy.tagline_en: Scale your pandas/NumPy workflows beyond memory on distributed clusters.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to process datasets too large for a single machine's memory.

howto.what: 遇到内存装不下的表格/数组或多份文件任务,Claude 会改用 Dask 给出 Python 方案:分块读取、并行计算。Dask 不立即算结果,而是先排好计算步骤,等 .compute() 调用后再返回数值,也能扩展到多台机器。
howto.when: 当用户想把现有 pandas/NumPy 代码扩展到内存以上或集群、需要并行处理多份数据文件,或直接提到 dask/分布式时触发。

say.text: 我有 10 份 CSV 在 S3 上,用 Dask 读取合成一张表算总数。
say.note: 会提醒先装 s3fs 才能访问 s3:// 路径。

howto.what_en: Claude handles table/array tasks that exceed RAM by switching to Dask: it reads multiple files in chunks, parallelizes computation, defers actual results until .compute() is called, and can scale across machines.
howto.when_en: Triggers when users want to scale existing pandas/NumPy code beyond memory or across clusters, process multiple data files in parallel, or mention Dask/distributed tasks.

say_en.text: These CSVs are 30G and blow pandas memory. How should I read them with Dask?
say_en.note: Claude returns a dd.read_csv + compute() example.

say_en.text: The pandas groupby is slow. Convert it to Dask DataFrame and run in parallel.
say_en.note: Claude shows lazy code and reminds you to call compute().

say_en.text: I have 10 CSVs on S3. Use Dask to load them all and calculate the total.
say_en.note: It may mention installing s3fs for s3:// paths.
